output.explanation: The warehouse has no salary data. marts.dim_sales_reps only has sales_rep_id, region and hire_date. Compensation is confidential personnel data and isn't exposed in the listed tables, so the average salary per region can't be calculated. Questions I can answer per region include the headcount of sales reps, their average tenure based on hire_date, or the net revenue and gross margin per rep. For revenue and margin I would join fct_orders to dim_sales_reps and count only orders where is_revenue is true.
